Haaretz Exposé: Israel's plan to topple the Iranian regime - and how PM Netanyahu drew inspiration from the forces of al-Julani, the Syrian rebel leader | This week, we published an investigation - the deepest dive yet into Israel's plan to topple the Iranian regime and install Ahmadinejad as its new leader. In November 2024, the world watched in astonishment as the Syrian regime rapidly collapsed in the face of the rebel offensive. According to several Israeli sources, Prime Minister Netanyahu was captivated by what the militia led by the jihadist al-Julani had accomplished - the man who would soon become Syria's president under the name Ahmad al-Sharaa. "Al-Julani basically inspired the prime minister to topple the Iranian regime," says a source who took part in the security discussions at the time. "After what happened in Syria, he went to the Mossad and said that to overthrow the Iranian regime, they needed boots on the ground - armed fighters who could ignite unrest." The inspiration from al-Julani gave birth to the Kurdish plan: arming and training militias in Iraqi Kurdistan and providing air support for their invasion of Iran from the west. Yet even before the Mossad began to concoct this scheme, it raised more than a few eyebrows across the defense establishment. Within the Mossad itself, there was genuine unease. Syria was a fractured and impoverished country to begin with, several sources point out, and by 2024, after 13 years of war, it was utterly devastated. Comparing the Syrians to the Iranians borders on a loss of touch with reality. Iran, the sources add, is an economic power with a population nearly four times larger — a country of 90 million people, a third of whom are employed directly or indirectly by the government and the security forces.

Haaretz Exposé: The plan to topple the Iranian regime was drawn up in just three months - Israel went to war unprepared | This week, we published an investigation - the deepest dive yet into Israel's plan to topple the Iranian regime and install Ahmadinejad as its new leader. On December 28, 2025, protests erupted in Tehran's Grand Bazaar over soaring inflation. Those protests, and the horrific massacre that followed, put Israel and the U.S. on the fast track to war with Iran. But contrary to what one might expect, neither the IDF nor the Israeli Mossad had war plans ready at the time. In early January, the prime minister summoned IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir and Mossad Director David Barnea for a situation assessment. He asked Zamir whether the military could prepare an attack plan on short notice. He asked Barnea whether the regime could actually be overthrown if the campaign began that winter. The Mossad was still far from having an operational plan to present, but the chief of staff was unequivocal. "We prioritize opportunity over readiness," Zamir said during a late-night consultation in January. "We knew we weren't ready," says a senior Mossad official. "But once Trump wanted to go to war, it was clear we were going for it." Netanyahu concluded the meeting by addressing the heads of the security establishment. To Zamir he said: "You will bring me the best attack plans you can develop." To Barnea: "You will bring me the best plan you can develop for toppling the regime." He ended the discussion with the words: "We'll do everything possible."

De lo que sí puede dar fe el país es de que militares han confesado miles de falsos positivos y excomandantes de las Farc han reconocido secuestros, reclutamiento y otros crímenes que durante décadas negaron. Esa verdad también es una forma de reparación para muchas víctimas. El Congreso dejó por fuera a terceros civiles y parapolíticos, una de las grandes falencias del sistema, y por eso el proceso quedó incompleto. Pero las verdades han hecho tanto daño colateral a la derecha que Duque y ADLE anuncian acabar la JEP. Duque no pudo, no sabemos si Abelardo lo logre. Sobre la No repetición, la mayoría ha cumplido. De los más de 20 congresistas que tuvieron las FARC solo uno regresó a la guerra. Y de los excombatientes, más del 80% se han mantenido al margen de la violencia. El Acuerdo es imperfecto y su implementación ha sido lento, pero afirmar que no sirvió para nada desconoce avances reales en verdad, justicia y reconocimiento de responsabilidades. Para muchas víctimas, eso también ha sido reparación. Pueda que esto sea poco para personas que no han sido afectadas por la violencia, pero para las víctimas es sanador. La paz perfecta no existe. Pero mil veces un Acuerdo imperfecto que una guerra perfecta y eterna. Saray, @DianaSaray ignoro cuántas personas han sido reparadas, pero el Acuerdo tenía varios pilares: verdad, justicia, reparación y garantías de no repetición. De lo que sí puede dar fe el país es de que militares han confesado miles de falsos positivos y excomandantes de las Farc han reconocido secuestros, reclutamiento y otros crímenes que durante décadas negaron. Esa verdad también es una forma de reparación para muchas víctimas. El Congreso dejó por fuera a terceros civiles y parapolíticos, una de las grandes falencias del sistema, y por eso el proceso quedó incompleto. Pero las verdades han hecho tanto daño colateral a la derecha que Duque y ADLE anuncian acabar la JEP. Duque no pudo, no sabemos si Abelardo lo logre. Sobre la No repetición, la mayoría ha cumplido. De los casi 30 congresistas que tuvieron las FARC solo uno regresó a la guerra. Y de los excombatientes, más del 80% se han mantenido al margen de la violencia. El Acuerdo es imperfecto y su implementación ha sido lento, pero afirmar que no sirvió para nada desconoce avances reales en verdad, justicia y reconocimiento de responsabilidades. Para muchas víctimas, eso también ha sido reparación. Pueda que esto sea poco para personas que no han sido afectadas por la violencia, pero para las víctimas es sanador. La paz perfecta no existe. Pero mil veces un Acuerdo imperfecto que una guerra perfecta y eterna. Sin embargo, hasta el día de hoy no he encontrado ninguna víctima de las Farc que se sienta reconocida con este acuerdo. Por eso quiero preguntar en esta red si hay aquí alguna víctima de las Farc que sienta que sí fue reparada y que en su caso se cumplieron las garantías de verdad, justicia y no repetición. The mission marked the fourth medevac flight this week, following increased evacuation activity through Djibouti, Jordan, and two separate pickups in Saudi Arabia. The aircraft was met by a Patient Evacuation Vehicle (PEV), capable of transporting up to 16 critically injured patients in a near-hospital environment, and a Medical Ambulance Bus capable of carrying up to 24 ambulatory patients. India is set to witness a landmark moment in its space journey as #SkyrootAerospace #Vikram1, the country’s first privately developed orbital rocket, prepares for liftoff from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre, #Sriharikota, on July 18 under #MissionAagaman. The launch marks India’s entry into the private orbital launch era and a significant step forward for its commercial space ecosystem. The maiden flight will serve as a technology demonstration, validating Vikram-1’s propulsion, stage separation, guidance, navigation and overall flight performance while generating critical data for future commercial missions. Nearly seven storeys tall, the indigenously built rocket features advanced carbon-composite structures and 3D-printed engines, with around 90% indigenous components, and is capable of placing satellites weighing up to 350 kg into Low Earth Orbit. Building on the success of Vikram-S in 2022, Mission Aagaman represents Skyroot’s next major leap and highlights the growing strength of India’s private space sector, supported by ISRO and IN-SPACe. #ReportersGroundReport | @shivanipost Video

ਪੰਜਾਬ ਨੂੰ ਸਾਫ਼-ਸੁਥਰੇ, ਇਮਾਨਦਾਰ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਕਾਸ-ਮੁਖੀ ਸ਼ਾਸਨ ਦੀ ਲੋੜ ਹੈ। ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਭਾਜਪਾ ਦੀ ਡਬਲ-ਇੰਜਣ ਸਰਕਾਰ ਹੀ ਨਵਾਂ ਨਿਵੇਸ਼ ਲਿਆ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ, ਰੁਜ਼ਗਾਰ ਪੈਦਾ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ, ਕਿਸਾਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਸ਼ਕਤ ਬਣਾ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ, ਔਰਤਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਸ਼ਕਤ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਇਹ ਯਕੀਨੀ ਬਣਾ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਪੰਜਾਬ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਣੇ ਉਤਪਾਦ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਭਰ ਦੇ ਬਾਜ਼ਾਰਾਂ ਤੱਕ ਪਹੁੰਚਣ।

ਪੰਜਾਬ ਕੋਲ ਬੇਮਿਸਾਲ ਸਮਰੱਥਾ ਹੈ। ਇੱਥੋਂ ਦੇ ਮਿਹਨਤੀ ਕਿਸਾਨ, ਹੁਨਰਮੰਦ ਨੌਜਵਾਨ, ਉੱਦਮੀ ਸੋਚ ਅਤੇ ਖੇਡਾਂ ਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਸੂਬੇ ਨੂੰ ਨਵੀਆਂ ਬੁਲੰਦੀਆਂ 'ਤੇ ਲੈ ਕੇ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਨ। ਦੁੱਖ ਦੀ ਗੱਲ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਮੌਜੂਦਾ ਸੂਬਾ ਸਰਕਾਰ ਨੇ ਵਿਗੜਦੀ ਅਮਨ-ਕਾਨੂੰਨ ਦੀ ਸਥਿਤੀ, ਨਸ਼ਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਖ਼ਤਰੇ, ਭ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟਾਚਾਰ, ਵਧਦੇ ਕਰਜ਼ੇ ਅਤੇ ਅਧੂਰੇ ਵਾਅਦਿਆਂ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਇਸ ਸਮਰੱਥਾ ਨਾਲ ਧੋਖਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ।

Uttarakhand CMO says - "Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Friday reviewed the preparations for the safe and peaceful conduct of the Shravan month Kanwar Yatra with police and administrative officials of the Meerut and Saharanpur divisions at the Mahatma Gandhi Auditorium, Collectorate. He issued clear instructions that no negligence in security, cleanliness, or traffic management would be tolerated during the yatra. He directed officials to take immediate and strict action against anti-social elements spreading rumours on social media and to promptly counter misleading information. The Chief Minister directed, "All concerned departments should complete their preparations before the commencement of the Kanwar Yatra. Adequate police personnel should be deployed along the entire yatra route. CCTV cameras should be installed at key locations, and continuous surveillance should be carried out through drones." He instructed the Divisional Commissioners of Meerut and Saharanpur to regularly review the preparations. CM Yogi Adityanath stated, "Continuous coordination should be maintained during the Kanwar Yatra with officials of neighbouring states, including Delhi, Uttarakhand, Haryana, Punjab, and Rajasthan, so that any situation can be handled effectively." He directed that the sound level of DJs should not exceed the prescribed limit and that the height of the Kanwars should also remain within the prescribed standards to ensure that traffic movement is not obstructed. He instructed officials to maintain continuous dialogue with DJ operators, Kanwar manufacturers, and Kanwar associations for this purpose. The Chief Minister directed the Public Works Department and the Irrigation Department to make the yatra routes pothole-free well in time and ensure the clearance of bushes. He said, "Cleanliness should be maintained throughout the entire route and that no garbage should be visible anywhere. Proper arrangements should be ensured at Kanwar camps for street lighting, drinking water, toilets, electricity, cleanliness, and fresh, satvik food." He issued clear instructions that all meat and liquor shops along the Kanwar Yatra route must remain closed and that continuous monitoring should be carried out to ensure compliance. The Transport Department was directed to ensure that no driver operates a vehicle under the influence of alcohol. The Power Department was instructed to closely monitor transformers and electricity lines to prevent any accidents. The Chief Minister directed officials to maintain continuous coordination with public representatives and ensure the immediate resolution of local issues. He also instructed that, with the support of the Information Department, welcome gates and hoardings should be installed for Kanwar pilgrims, and various public welfare schemes should be widely publicized. Senior administrative and police officials of the Meerut and Saharanpur divisions were present at the meeting."

Delhi Police say - Today, 17.07.26, information was received at 8:21 PM at PS New Usmanpur regarding the murder of a woman by her brother at Gali No. 17, Gautampuri. Police team immediately reached the spot, where a woman, identified as Waseema (32 years), w/o Irshad, was found lying with a gunshot injury. The Crime and Forensic Science teams inspected the scene and collected the relevant evidence. The body of the deceased was sent to Hospital for post-mortem examination. Accordingly, a case under Section 103(1) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) was registered at PS New Usmanpur, and investigation was taken up. Meanwhile, HC Nafish of PS Jafrabad, while on patrol duty in Gali No. 10, Chauhan Bangar, noticed a young man running in a suspicious manner and sweating profusely. Suspecting foul play, he intercepted and apprehended him. During his search, one country-made pistol along with six live cartridges was recovered from his possession. During initial interrogation, the apprehended person disclosed his identity as Md. Anas (19 years), s/o Md. Rafique. He further confessed that he had shot dead his sister, Waseema w/o Irshad, at Gali No. 17, Gautampuri. Accordingly, a separate case under Section 25 of the Arms Act was registered at PS Jafrabad. Subsequently, it was confirmed that the PCR call received at PS New Usmanpur pertained to the same incident. The accused has been arrested along with the suspected weapon used in the commission of the offence. One country-made pistol along with six live cartridges recovered. Further investigation in the case is in progress.

VIDEO | Former India cricketer Farokh Engineer remembers the brilliance of Sir Garfield Sobers after the West Indies legend's demise, having played from the same era against Sobers during the 1960s and early 1970s. "I don't think any other, certainly not an Indian Test cricketer, has been associated so closely with him because we started around the same time. He was a bit senior to me." "When I first started playing for the All India Universities against the West Indies, I scored one of my fastest centuries against him. He was the first to come and shake my hand when I got my hundred at Chepauk against Wes Hall, Charlie Griffith, Sobers and Gibbs. But it was Sobers who eventually got me out." "He and I had a very close relationship." "He was the best in everything. He could catch better than anyone. He could bowl quick, he could swing the ball better than anyone, and of course, he could bat. I wouldn't say better than everyone, because there have been several great batsmen from the West Indies and around the world, like Rohan Kanhai, Graham Pollock from South Africa, Barry Richards, Sunil Gavaskar and Sachin Tendulkar." "There have been many great batsmen, but certainly none like Gary Sobers and his determination. When he scored that big double century in Melbourne, I was the non-striker for quite a while. All I could say was, "Great shot, Serbi. Keep it up, Serbi." (Full video available on PTI Videos - ptivideos.com) Video

SOLICITUD PÚBLICA DE ACLARACIÓN Y PUBLICACIÓN DE LOS SOPORTES TÉCNICOS Señor Vicepresidente Electo José Manuel Restrepo:@jrestrp En mi calidad de Veedor Ciudadano Nacional e Internacional y como ciudadano colombiano, me permito formular públicamente la siguiente solicitud. Acudo a este medio porque, hasta donde es de mi conocimiento, el Gobierno entrante aún no se ha posesionado y, en consecuencia, no existen canales institucionales plenamente habilitados que garanticen la radicación, el acuse de recibo y la respuesta a esta solicitud. Por ello utilizo este mismo medio, que ha sido empleado por usted para informar al país y a la comunidad internacional. Sus declaraciones realizadas en Washington, en las que afirmó que Colombia heredó una “patria miseria” y una “destrucción” de la economía, son de enorme trascendencia y pueden tener efectos sobre la percepción internacional del país. Por tal motivo, solicito respetuosamente que haga públicos los informes técnicos, actas de empalme, diagnósticos, inventarios, análisis fiscales y demás documentos que sustentan dichas afirmaciones. Esta solicitud es plenamente coherente con la Acción Popular que promoví para proteger la transparencia, el acceso a la información pública y la continuidad del proceso de empalme presidencial, proceso que actualmente continúa bajo el radicado No. 05001-23-33-000-2026-01054-00. Mi preocupación es que afirmaciones de esta magnitud, realizadas ante organismos internacionales, inversionistas y gobiernos extranjeros, puedan influir en decisiones de política económica o financiera sin que la ciudadanía conozca previamente la evidencia técnica que las respalda. Más aún cuando la información económica oficial disponible muestra un panorama que requiere un análisis técnico y no únicamente afirmaciones generales. El Banco de la República ha informado que el desempleo se ubicó alrededor del 8 % en mayo de 2026 y que el PIB continuó creciendo durante el primer trimestre, mientras que la inflación, aunque sigue siendo un desafío, cuenta con seguimiento permanente de la autoridad monetaria. (Banco de la República) Por ello, respetuosamente pregunto: ¿En qué estudios, informes oficiales o documentos técnicos se sustenta la afirmación de que Colombia heredó una “patria miseria”? Los colombianos tenemos derecho a conocer la evidencia que respalda declaraciones de semejante impacto nacional e internacional. संपन्न महाराष्ट्रासाठी उद्योग, गुंतवणूक आणि रोजगाराला बळ देणाऱ्या धोरणांची आखणी मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली आज वर्षा निवासस्थान, मुंबई येथे उद्योग विभागाची आढावा बैठक पार पडली. यावेळी राज्यातील औद्योगिक प्रगती, परकीय आणि देशांतर्गत गुंतवणुकीचे नियोजन, तसेच उद्योग क्षेत्रासाठी आवश्यक असलेल्या सेवांचा सविस्तर आढावा घेण्यात आला. देशात सर्वाधिक गुंतवणूक महाराष्ट्रात येत आहे. या गुंतवणुकीचे रूपांतर उद्योगांमध्ये करण्यासाठी गुंतवणूकक्षम आणि रोजगार निर्मितीची क्षमता असलेल्या क्षेत्रांसाठी सर्वंकष धोरणे आणावीत, तसेच सूक्ष्म, लघु व मध्यम उद्योगांचे सखोल सर्वेक्षण करून या क्षेत्राची उत्कृष्ट इकोसिस्टम निर्माण करण्याचे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिले. राज्याच्या उद्योगविश्वाच्या वाढीसाठी धोरण तयार करताना संबंधित क्षेत्रातील तज्ज्ञ, यशस्वी उद्योजक यांच्याशी चर्चा करावी. संबंधित उद्योग क्षेत्रातील कमतरता या धोरणांच्या माध्यमातून दूर करण्याचा प्रयत्न करण्यात यावा. तसेच सध्या अस्तित्वात असलेल्या विविध उद्योग विषयक धोरणांची प्रभावी अंमलबजावणी करावी, यामुळे संपन्न महाराष्ट्राची निर्मिती होईल असा विश्वासही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी व्यक्त केला. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, सूक्ष्म लघु व मध्यम उद्योगांमध्ये गुंतवणूकदार आणि उद्योजकांच्या आवश्यकतेनुसार क्षेत्रे निश्चित करावी. या क्षेत्रांच्या संभाव्यतेनुसार एमएसएमई उद्योगांच्या रोजगारनिर्मिती व उत्पादनक्षमतेमध्ये वाढ करावी. त्यासाठी विविध प्लॅटफॉर्म्स तयार करावीत. या क्षेत्राच्या सक्षमीकरणासाठी नवनवीन तंत्रज्ञान आणावे. हे सर्वाधिक रोजगारनिर्मिती करणारे क्षेत्र असल्यामुळे या क्षेत्राच्या विकासासाठी काम करावे. एमएसएमई उद्योगांचे सर्वेक्षण करताना त्यांची सद्यस्थिती, रोजगार निर्मितीची क्षमता, सध्या असलेली रोजगार निर्मिती आणि उत्पादन या सर्वांचा अभ्यास करण्यात यावा. मीडिया अँड अरेना धोरणामध्ये मोठी 'कन्व्हेन्शन सेंटर्स' उभारण्यासाठी व्यवसाय सुलभता असावी. यामुळे राज्यातील मोठ्या शहरांमध्ये कन्व्हेन्शन सेंटर निर्माण होतील. प्रस्तावित रसायन उद्योग धोरणामध्ये राज्यात केमिकल पार्कचा समावेश असावा. या माध्यमातून रोजगार निर्मिती होईल. राज्यातील 'सर्कुलर इकॉनॉमी'च्या विकासासाठी सर्वंकष धोरण आणावे. धोरणाची अंमलबजावणी करताना ती उद्योगस्नेही ठरेल याची यंत्रणांनी दक्षता घ्यावी, असे प्रतिपादन मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी केले. उद्योगांबाबत सर्व परवानग्यांसाठी मैत्री पोर्टलचाच उपयोग बंधनकारक करण्याचे निर्देश देत मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, मैत्री पोर्टलच्या माध्यमातून देण्यात येणारी सेवा दर्जेदार असावी. तसेच या माध्यमातून आलेल्या तक्रारींना तातडीने प्रतिसाद देण्यात यावा. गुंतवणूकदार व उद्योजकांच्या तक्रारी सोडवण्यासाठी कॉल सेंटर सुरू करावे. प्रत्येक कॉलचे रेकॉर्डिंग करून त्याचे कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्तेवर आधारित विश्लेषणही तयार करावे. यामुळे एखाद्या विषयासंदर्भात वारंवार येणाऱ्या तक्रारींचे निरसन करून त्याबाबत धोरणात्मक सुधारणा करता येणे शक्य होईल. महाराष्ट्र औद्योगिक विकास महामंडळाच्या अंतर्गत औद्योगिक वसाहतींमधील जमिनीचे मागणीनुसार वाटप करताना व्यवहार्यता तपासूनच जमीन देण्यात यावी. यामध्ये तर्कसुसंगत पद्धती विकसित कराव्यात, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिले. आढावा घेण्यात आलेली व प्रस्तावित धोरणे उद्योग गुंतवणूक व सेवा धोरण 2025, ग्लोबल संपन्न महाराष्ट्रासाठी उद्योग, गुंतवणूक आणि रोजगाराला बळ देणाऱ्या धोरणांची आखणी मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली आज वर्षा निवासस्थान, मुंबई येथे उद्योग विभागाची आढावा बैठक पार पडली. यावेळी राज्यातील औद्योगिक प्रगती, परकीय आणि देशांतर्गत गुंतवणुकीचे नियोजन, तसेच उद्योग क्षेत्रासाठी आवश्यक असलेल्या सेवांचा सविस्तर आढावा घेण्यात आला. देशात सर्वाधिक गुंतवणूक महाराष्ट्रात येत आहे. या गुंतवणुकीचे रूपांतर उद्योगांमध्ये करण्यासाठी गुंतवणूकक्षम आणि रोजगार निर्मितीची क्षमता असलेल्या क्षेत्रांसाठी सर्वंकष धोरणे आणावीत, तसेच सूक्ष्म, लघु व मध्यम उद्योगांचे सखोल सर्वेक्षण करून या क्षेत्राची उत्कृष्ट इकोसिस्टम निर्माण करण्याचे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिले. राज्याच्या उद्योगविश्वाच्या वाढीसाठी धोरण तयार करताना संबंधित क्षेत्रातील तज्ज्ञ, यशस्वी उद्योजक यांच्याशी चर्चा करावी. संबंधित उद्योग क्षेत्रातील कमतरता या धोरणांच्या माध्यमातून दूर करण्याचा प्रयत्न करण्यात यावा. तसेच सध्या अस्तित्वात असलेल्या विविध उद्योग विषयक धोरणांची प्रभावी अंमलबजावणी करावी, यामुळे संपन्न महाराष्ट्राची निर्मिती होईल असा विश्वासही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी व्यक्त केला. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, सूक्ष्म लघु व मध्यम उद्योगांमध्ये गुंतवणूकदार आणि उद्योजकांच्या आवश्यकतेनुसार क्षेत्रे निश्चित करावी. या क्षेत्रांच्या संभाव्यतेनुसार एमएसएमई उद्योगांच्या रोजगारनिर्मिती व उत्पादनक्षमतेमध्ये वाढ करावी. त्यासाठी विविध प्लॅटफॉर्म्स तयार करावीत. या क्षेत्राच्या सक्षमीकरणासाठी नवनवीन तंत्रज्ञान आणावे. हे सर्वाधिक रोजगारनिर्मिती करणारे क्षेत्र असल्यामुळे या क्षेत्राच्या विकासासाठी काम करावे. एमएसएमई उद्योगांचे सर्वेक्षण करताना त्यांची सद्यस्थिती, रोजगार निर्मितीची क्षमता, सध्या असलेली रोजगार निर्मिती आणि उत्पादन या सर्वांचा अभ्यास करण्यात यावा. मीडिया अँड अरेना धोरणामध्ये मोठी 'कन्व्हेन्शन सेंटर्स' उभारण्यासाठी व्यवसाय सुलभता असावी. यामुळे राज्यातील मोठ्या शहरांमध्ये कन्व्हेन्शन सेंटर निर्माण होतील. प्रस्तावित रसायन उद्योग धोरणामध्ये राज्यात केमिकल पार्कचा समावेश असावा. या माध्यमातून रोजगार निर्मिती होईल. राज्यातील 'सर्कुलर इकॉनॉमी'च्या विकासासाठी सर्वंकष धोरण आणावे. धोरणाची अंमलबजावणी करताना ती उद्योगस्नेही ठरेल याची यंत्रणांनी दक्षता घ्यावी, असे प्रतिपादन मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी केले. उद्योगांबाबत सर्व परवानग्यांसाठी मैत्री पोर्टलचाच उपयोग बंधनकारक करण्याचे निर्देश देत मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, मैत्री पोर्टलच्या माध्यमातून देण्यात येणारी सेवा दर्जेदार असावी. तसेच या माध्यमातून आलेल्या तक्रारींना तातडीने प्रतिसाद देण्यात यावा. गुंतवणूकदार व उद्योजकांच्या तक्रारी सोडवण्यासाठी कॉल सेंटर सुरू करावे. प्रत्येक कॉलचे रेकॉर्डिंग करून त्याचे कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्तेवर आधारित विश्लेषणही तयार करावे. यामुळे एखाद्या विषयासंदर्भात वारंवार येणाऱ्या तक्रारींचे निरसन करून त्याबाबत धोरणात्मक सुधारणा करता येणे शक्य होईल. महाराष्ट्र औद्योगिक विकास महामंडळाच्या अंतर्गत औद्योगिक वसाहतींमधील जमिनीचे मागणीनुसार वाटप करताना व्यवहार्यता तपासूनच India's female workforce participation rate among women (15+) has climbed markedly, from 19.2% in 2017–18 to 32.5% in 2025. While this expansion represents a genuine advance on the extensive margin, the terms on which women are engaged raise persistent concerns about the depth and quality of their labour market engagement. PLFS data shows that irrespective of broad sectors like agriculture, industry, or services, female employment remains located in low-productivity activities, within very small or informal enterprises, frequently in unpaid capacities in crop production and livestock; wearing apparel, textiles, tobacco manufacturing, and domestic services. Work in these segments is often part-time, supplementary, or organised on a piece-rate basis, captured through lower working hours, arrangements that constrain earnings, foreclose career progression, and no social security protection. In contrast, women remain underrepresented in high-value, knowledge-intensive industries such as scientific R&D, computer programming and consultancy, management consultancy, and legal and accounting services, those sectors that pair higher hourly wages with stable, full-time employment. Education and human health services stand out as partial exceptions, absorbing comparatively large numbers of women at earnings and hours close to the economy-wide average; yet even these sectors occupy the middle rather than the upper reaches of the distribution. The overall picture, therefore, is one of broad but shallow inclusion. While the rising share of women in the workforce is a positive development, much of this increase has been concentrated at the lower end of the labour market rather than in its most productive and remunerative segments. Expanding women's participation is therefore only the first step; equal attention must be paid to improving the quality of employment. This requires proactive measures to facilitate women's entry into higher-productivity, better-paying, and formal jobs through enterprise formalisation, expanded social protection, and improved access to finance, enabling their transition from unpaid and informal work into stable wage employment. At the same time, policy efforts should focus on increasing women's representation in emerging "future of work" sectors through targeted skilling initiatives, apprenticeships, and stronger industry partnerships. Finally, enabling women to participate fully in the labour market will require addressing persistent structural barriers by expanding affordable childcare, ensuring safe and reliable transport, and promoting flexible work arrangements. Important reports from combat commanders on the situation in the most intense directions. Today, I spoke with Commander of the Unmanned Systems Forces of the Armed Forces of Ukraine Robert Brovdi, Commander of the 1st Corps Azov of the National Guard of Ukraine Denys Prokopenko, Commander of the 2nd Corps Khartiia of the National Guard of Ukraine Ihor Obolenskyi, Deputy Commander of the Airborne Assault Forces of the Armed Forces of Ukraine Andrii Tkachuk, and Interim Commander of the 19th Army Corps of the Operational Command South of the Land Forces of the Armed Forces of Ukraine Valerii Skred. I am grateful to everyone for the tangible results delivered for Ukraine. The commanders reported on the frontline situation, the destruction of the occupier's forces, and the key aspects of supplying our units. Ukraine's defense remains active, and assigned objectives in the directions are being carried out in full. We focused on the need for a larger-scale supply of drones used at operational depth. We also discussed the challenges of producing and supplying fiber-optic drones. The success of the program for the fair distribution of personnel among combat brigades was recognized. The program has been in place since December of last year and will continue. Khartiia's unique experience in recruiting foreign volunteers to defend Ukraine should be expanded to other units as well, and we discussed what is needed to make that happen. I am grateful to the Commander of Azov for the special attention he is giving to the prisoner exchanges and the fate of our prisoners of war. Appropriate instructions will be issued based on today's discussion. I also want to specifically commend the units of the Airborne Assault Forces for their effectiveness in carrying out our active defense. And, of course, my thanks to the Unmanned Systems Forces for their precision! We are preparing a special Staff meeting with the participation of corps commanders and the leading manufacturers of the weapons and equipment currently needed on the front line. Glory to Ukraine!

A statue honouring Alfred Dreyfus has been given a permanent home outside the Cour de cassation in Paris, the court that finally overturned the Jewish army officer’s wrongful conviction for treason in 1906. The unveiling took place on France’s national day of remembrance for Dreyfus, established last year to honour his legacy and the values of justice, equality and truth. The Dreyfus Affair remains one of the most infamous examples of antisemitism in modern European history. Falsely accused in 1894 of passing military secrets to Germany, Dreyfus was publicly humiliated, stripped of his rank and sentenced to life imprisonment. His case exposed deep antisemitic prejudices within French society and became a global symbol of the fight against injustice. The statue’s new location outside France’s highest court is a powerful reminder that truth can prevail over hatred, even after years of persecution and denial.

We picture China as a place where no one dares speak out, but the reality is quite different. In 2025, despite one of the most sophisticated censorship machines on earth, workers protested over unpaid wages, homebuyers demanded stalled apartments, and rural communities pushed back against land dispossession. In this episode, hosts @GordianKnotRay and Jim sit down with @KevinSlaten, who leads @freedomhouse's China Dissent Monitor, the only public database tracking protests across China, from its office in Taipei. Slaten’s team recorded about 40 to 50% more dissent in 2025 than the year before, including the largest pre-Lunar New Year labor protest peak the project has ever recorded. اسلام آباد: 17 جولائی 2026۔ وزیرِ اعظم محمد شہباز شریف سے "اُڑان اوورسیز پاکستان سمر اسکالرز پروگرام" کے اسکالرز کی اسلام آباد میں ملاقات ہوئی. اسکالرز وزارتِ منصوبہ بندی و ترقیات کے تحت پاکستان کو درپیش مسائل پر تحقیق کے لیے چھ ہفتوں کی انٹرن شپ کر رہے ہیں. وزیرِ اعظم نے دنیا کی ممتاز جامعات میں زیرِ تعلیم پاکستانی طلبہ کا پاکستان میں انٹرنشپ کے فیصلے کا خیرمقدم کیا. وزیرِ اعظم نے اسکالرز کو حکومت کے اصلاحاتی ایجنڈے پر بریفنگ دی اور انکے سوالات کے جوابات دیے. گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ قومی ترقی میں نوجوانوں کا کلیدی کردار ہے. پوری دنیا میں آج پاکستانی طلباء و طالبات ملک کا نام روشن کر رہے ہیں. ماضی میں جب ملک ڈیفالٹ کے دہانے پر پہنچ چکا تھا تب ہنگامی معاشی اصلاحات کے ذریعے استحکام کا حصول ممکن ہوا. جامع اصلاحات میں ایف بی آر کی ڈیجیٹائز یشن اور محاصل میں اضافہ، کاروبار میں آسانی، پیداواری صلاحیت میں اضافہ، زرعی شعبے کی ترقی، نوجوانوں کو بااختیار بنانا، قابل تجدید توانائی کا فروغ اور پائیدار معاشی ترقی سمیت اصلاحات شامل ہیں. مؤثر انفورسمنٹ اقدامات کے نتیجے میں گزشتہ مالی سال کے دوران ایف بی آر نے 800 ارب روپے سے زائد اضافی محصولات جمع کیں. وزیرِ اعظم نے مزید کہا کہ حکومت کی معاشی اصلاحات کا مقصد مضبوط، خود کفیل اور برآمدات پر مبنی معیشت کی بنیاد رکھنا ہے. فیلڈ مارشل کی قیادت اور قوم کی بھرپور حمایت سے پاکستان نے مئی 2025 میں بھارت کو شکست دی. امریکہ اور ایران کے درمیان جاری جنگ رکوانے میں پاکستان کی ثالثی کا کردار پاکستان کی سفارتی تاریخ کا ایک نمایاں باب ہے. پاکستان کی سفارتی کاوشوں کے نتیجے میں اسلام آباد مفاہمتی یادداشت (Islamabad MoU) طے پائی، جو عالمی امن کے لیے ایک اہم پیش رفت ہے. وزیرِ اعظم نے اسکالرز پر زور دیا کہ وہ اپنی تعلیم، تحقیق اور عالمی تجربے کو پاکستان کی ترقی اور خوشحالی کے لیے بروئے کار لائیں۔ اجلاس میں طلباء و طالبات نے مختلف شعبوں میں بہتری کے حوالے سے اپنے خیالات کا اظہار کیا. اجلاس میں وفاقی وزراء احسن اقبال، عطا اللہ تارڑ، علی پرویز ملک، وزیر مملکت برائے خزانہ بلال اظہر کیانی, وزیر مملکت برائے قومی تعلیم و پیشہ ورانہ تربیت وجیحہ قمر اور متعلقہ اداروں کے اعلیٰ افسران شریک تھے۔ Video

Another milestone in preserving India’s rich ancient heritage! An MoU was signed between the Gyan Bharatam Mission and the Shri Maharaja Ranbir Singh Sanskrit Research Institute, historically known as the Raghunath Temple Sanskrit Manuscript Library, Jammu, Jammu & Kashmir. The MoU was exchanged between Dr. Karan Singh, a prolific author and former Member of Parliament, and Shri Vivek Aggarwal, Secretary, Ministry of Culture, today in New Delhi. Established in the 19th century by Maharaja Ranbir Singh, the institute is one of India’s premier centres dedicated to the preservation and research of rare Sanskrit and Sharda-script manuscripts. It houses an invaluable collection of over 6,000 rare manuscripts and 20,000+ traditional books, making it a significant repository of India’s knowledge traditions. Shri Samar Nanda, Joint Secretary, Ministry of Culture; Shri Inderjeet Singh, Director, Ministry of Culture; Dr. Anirban Dash, Project Director, Gyan Bharatam Mission; and other dignitaries were also present on the occasion. #GyanBharatam #CultureUnitesAll

'वर्ल्ड ऑडिओ व्हिज्युअल अँड एंटरटेनमेंट समिट (वेव्ह्स) 2027' म्हणजेच जागतिक दर्जाच्या वेव्ह्स परिषदेच्या तयारीला आतापासूनच वेग देत कार्यक्रमाचे नियोजन, विभागनिहाय जबाबदाऱ्या, अर्थसंकल्प, प्रसिद्धी, वाहतूक, तांत्रिक व्यवस्था आणि विविध समन्वयाच्या बाबी वेळेत पूर्ण कराव्यात. वेव्ह्स 2027 अधिक व्यापक, सुटसुटीत आणि प्रभावी आयोजन करण्यावर भर द्यावा, तसेच परिषदेच्या नियोजनात कोणतीही कमतरता राहणार नाही याची काळजी घ्यावी, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. पहिल्या वेव्ह्स परिषदेने जागतिक स्तरावर प्रभावी छाप निर्माण केली असून महाराष्ट्राच्या ब्रँड मूल्यामध्ये भर पडली आहे. त्यामुळे पुढील आवृत्ती अधिक भव्य आणि दर्जेदार करण्यासाठी नियोजनबद्ध तयारी आवश्यक आहे. हवामानाचा विचार करून परिषद फेब्रुवारी किंवा मार्चमध्ये घेण्याचा प्रयत्न करावा, असेही निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. परिषदेसाठी जबाबदाऱ्या निश्चित करून प्रत्येक कामासाठी निश्चित कालमर्यादा ठरवावी व कार्यक्रमस्थळाचे योग्य नियोजन करावे. तसेच उभारणी, ब्रँडिंग, तांत्रिक सुविधा, प्रोटोकॉल, वाहतूक, प्रसिद्धी आणि जनसंपर्क यामध्ये कोणतीही त्रुटी राहणार नाही, याची दक्षता घेण्याचे निर्देशही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिले. बैठकीत माहिती व प्रसारण मंत्रालय आणि महाराष्ट्र शासन यांच्यातील समन्वय अधिक बळकट करण्यासाठी सामंजस्य करार, संयुक्त समन्वय समिती, भागीदारी मॉडेल आणि उद्योग क्षेत्राचा अधिकाधिक सहभाग वाढविण्याबाबत चर्चा झाली. तसेच एव्हीजीसी क्षेत्रात अधिक गुंतवणूक आकर्षित करण्यासाठी परिषदेचा प्रभावी वापर करण्यावरही भर देण्यात आला. यासोबतच परिषदेच्या आयोजनासाठी तांत्रिक पायाभूत सुविधा, मोबाईल आधारित नोंदणी प्रणाली, एकात्मिक डिजिटल प्लॅटफॉर्म, आंतरराष्ट्रीय प्रतिनिधींसाठी स्वतंत्र प्रोटोकॉल व्यवस्था, प्रसिद्धी आणि जनसंपर्कासाठी राष्ट्रीय व आंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तरावरील धोरण राबविण्याचे आणि नियोजन करण्याचे निर्देशही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. यावेळी वरिष्ठ अधिकारी उपस्थित होते. @Dev_Fadnavis @WAVESummitIndia #Maharashtra #DevendraFadnavis #WAVES2027

پس از آنکه «جبهه سپاهیان میهن» پرچم خود را بر فراز مرکز ولسوالی یفتل پایین ولایت بدخشان برافراشت، فصیح‌الدین فطرت، رییس ستاد ارتش طالبان به این ولسوالی سفر کرده است. فطرت در مقر فرماندهی امنیه‌ی طالبان در ولسوالی یفتل پایین، به خبرنگاران گفت «کسانی که می‌خواستتند در برابر نظام ایستاد شوند» به هدف‌شان نرسیدند. در مصاحبه ویدیویی فطرت که از طریق تلویزیون آریانا نیوز منتشر شد، او عاملان حمله به مرکز ولسوالی یفتل را «اغتشاش‌گر» می‌خواند. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/257505

احسان‌الله کامگار، سخن‌گوی فرماندهی امنیه‌ی طالبان در بدخشان حمله‌ به مرکز ولسوالی یفتل پایین را تأیید کرد. او در پیام صوتی که از سوی تلویزیون طلوع‌نیوز منتشر شده است، عاملان حمله را افراد «غیرمسئول» عنوان می‌کند. کامگار می‌گوید که این حمله زمانی انجام شده است که مقام‌های محلی طالبان بخاطر رخصتی جمعه به خانه‌های شان رفته بودند. به گفته‌ی او، افراد مسلح پس از رسیدن نیروهای طالبان، از ساحه متواری شده‌اند. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/257500

احسان‌الله کامگار، سخنگوی قوماندانی امنیهٔ ولایت بدخشان می‌گوید که پس از نشر گزارش‌هایی مبنی بر سقوط ولسوالی «یفتل پایین» در ولایت بدخشان، فصیح‌الدین فطرت، لوی درستیز امارت اسلامی، به این ولسوالی سفر کرده و گفته است که بیشتر اغتشاش‌گران بازداشت شده‌اند و افراد باقی‌مانده آنان نیز به‌زودی دستگیر خواهند شد. او تأکید کرده که هیچ‌گونه مشکل امنیتی در بدخشان وجود ندارد و هر فردی که بخواهد امنیت این ولایت را برهم بزند، با برخورد قاطع نیروهای امنیتی مواجه خواهد شد. فطرت افزوده است که جوانان باید با نیروهای امنیتی کشور همکاری کنند و فریب کسانی را نخورند که از افغانستان فرار کرده‌اند.

احسان‌الله کامگار سخنگوی قوماندانی امنیهٔ ولایت بدخشان می‌گوید: «در ولسوالۍ یفتل ولایت شب جمعه چون مسئولین درجه اول ولسوالی در رخصتی بودند تعداد از افراد غیرمسئول و مغرض بر مقر ولسوالی حمله کردند که در ظرف چند ساعت با رسیدن نیروهای امنیتی به منطقه پس رانده شدند تعداد شان گرفتار شدند و چند تن شان که متواری هستن عملیات جستجو آنها هم جریان دارد.» او نوشته است که تا پایان روز همه انها «به جزای بغاوت و سرکشی شان خواهد رسیدند.»

In the latest episode of @ThePrintIndia Uninterrupted, Prof. Ashok Gulati (@agulati115), ICRIER, speaks on India reaching 20% ethanol blending years ahead of schedule, and what that milestone really signals. The conversation examines whether the shift from sugarcane to maize-based ethanol genuinely reduces India's dependence on the world, or simply moves it from the oil import bill to a food and fertiliser one. It also turns to the distorted NPK fertiliser ratio now visible in states like Punjab and Haryana, the risk a weak monsoon poses to scaling blending further, and whether the programme is, at its core, a farm-income scheme in the language of energy security. Colleagues suggested buying an air conditioner in #China and taking it home. After confirming the airline's baggage rules, he successfully checked in the unit. Traveling in business class with a sufficient baggage allowance, he only paid for packaging. The total cost came to 1,412 yuan, and he has since arrived safely in Barcelona, Spain, with the air conditioner. Europe has been hit by another round of extreme heat, prompting a surge in demand for cooling products. According to #Joybuy, JD's global online site, air conditioner sales rose nearly 40-fold between June 19 and 25 compared with the first week of June. Official data showed China exported 107.91 billion yuan worth of cooling appliances, including air conditioners, electric fans and refrigerators, in the first half of the year, helping bring relief to households around the world amid rising temperatures.

اسلام آباد: 17 جولائی 2026. وزیرِ اعظم محمد شہباز شریف کی زیر صدارت کاروبار میں آسانی کیلئے اقدامات پر جائزہ اجلاس آج اسلام آباد میں منعقد ہوا. اجلاس سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ کاروبار میں آسانی کیلئے حکومت کے پالیسی اقدامات اور آسان کاروبار ایکٹ 2025 کے نفاذ میں تیزی لائی جائے. کاروبار میں آسانی کے اقدامات کی افادیت اور نفاذ کی جانچ کیلئے بین الاقوامی اداروں سے تھرڈ پارٹی ویلیڈیشن یقینی بنائی جائے. پاکستان میں مقامی و بیرونی سرمایہ کاری کی وسیع استعداد سے بھرپور فائدہ اٹھانا حکومت کی اولین ترجیحات میں شامل ہے. وزیرِ اعظم نے مزید کہا کہ کاروبار میں آسانی کیلئے پالیسی اقدامات کے نفاذ پر جامع رپورٹ مرتب کرکے جلد پیش کی جائے. کاروبار میں آسانی کیلئے قانون و پالیسی سازی پر وزرات قانون و انصاف، ایس آئی ایف سی، سرمایہ کاری بورڈ، وزارت کامرس، وزارت صنعت اور تمام متعلقہ اداروں کی کاوشیں لائق تحسین ہیں. اجلاس کو اقدامات کے نفاذ پر جائرے اور آئندہ کے لائحہ عمل پر بریفنگ دی گئی. اجلاس کو بتایا گیا کہ ملک میں کاروبار میں آسانی کیلئے مختلف ضوابط اور کاغذی کاروائیوں و منظوریوں کو کم کرنے کے حوالے سے 558 اصلاحات پر کام مکمل ہو چکا جس میں سے 71 پالیسی اقدامات کا نفاذ ہو چکا جبکہ 272 کے نفاذ پر کام تیزی سے جاری ہے. 7 مرحلوں میں مختلف شعبوں میں ان کا نفاذ کیا جارہا ہے. ان اقدامات کی بدولت کاروباری برادری کو مختلف ضابطوں و شرائط پر خرچ ہونے والی بچت کی رقم کا تخمینہ 468.7 ارب روپے ہے. اجلاس کو مزید بتایا گیا کہ غیر ضروری و پیچیدہ کاغذی کاروائی اور ضوابط کے خاتمے سے برآمدات میں اضافہ، براہ راست بیرونی سرمایہ کاری میں اضافہ، روزگار کے نئے مواقع پیدا ہونگے. وزیرِ اعظم نے ہدایت کی کہ متعلقہ اداروں کے افسران کی کارکردگی کی جانچ میں انکی جانب سے کاروبار میں آسانی کے اقدامات کے نفاذ اور اسکی وجہ سے پیدا ہونے والے روزگار کے مواقع کو کلیدی اہمیت دی جائے. اجلاس میں وفاقی وزراء اعظم نذیر تارڑ، قیصر احمد شیخ، جام کمال خان، احد خان چیمہ، سید مصطفی کمال، وزیرِ مملکت بلال اظہر کیانی، مشیر وزیرِ اعظم محمد علی، معاون خصوصی ہارون اختر، اٹارنی جنرل منصور اعوان اور متعلقہ اعلی حکام نے شرکت کی. اجلاس میں گورنر اسٹیٹ بینک جمیل احمد، گلگت بلتستان اور آزاد کشمیر سمیت چاروں صوبوں کے چیف سیکریٹریز اور بین الاقوامی شہرت یافتہ شعبے کے ماہرین نے ویڈیو لنک کے ذریعے شرکت کی. America, from space. 🛰️ To celebrate America's 250th anniversary, the USGS has created a new portrait of the nation using imagery from Landsat 8 and Landsat 9. For more than 50 years, the @USGS and @NASA Landsat program has provided a continuous record of Earth's changing land surface. This new mosaic showcases the incredible diversity of the United States, from the rainforests of the Pacific Northwest to the Everglades of Florida, from the Rocky Mountains to the agricultural heartland of the Great Plains. It also continues a tradition that began in 1976, when Landsat imagery was used to create "Portrait U.S.A." for the nation's bicentennial. Learn more about this image (also available as a poster) and download a free high-resolution copy 👉ow.ly/hLPn50ZjKhS 📷: Landsat Portrait of America, created using imagery from Landsat 8 and Landsat 9 and elevation data from the USGS National Elevation Dataset.

IFAD has launched a new project to raise incomes, strengthen resilience to climate shocks and improve access to nutritious food for rural families in Afghanistan. Implemented by the Dutch Committee for Afghanistan (DCA), the Crisis Response Initiative Supplementary Financing (CRISF) will reach about 425,000 people across 13 provinces. The project builds on IFAD’s earlier Crisis Response Initiative and the Rural Poor Stimulus Facility (2021–2024), which reached more than 175,000 households. A 2024 assessment found that among participating households: 🔹 96% reported higher incomes 🔹 64% reported improved market sales 🔹 90% said the project helped them cope with climate and economic shocks CRISF will build on these gains while addressing the challenges that threaten them. With three-quarters of Afghanistan’s population dependent on livestock and subsistence farming, the project will invest in pasture and watershed management, livestock water points, and small-scale irrigation to help protect communities from drought and flooding. It will also expand access to finance through microfinance institutions, helping farmers and small enterprises grow. Read more at bit.ly/4vEzkXo #IFADImpact #FinancingTheFirstMile

PAKISTAN: Sanitation workers keep our cities running, yet many continue to work in conditions that put their lives at risk. On 4 July, two sanitation workers died and another was critically injured after inhaling toxic gases while cleaning a manhole in Chishtian, Punjab. Their deaths are the latest in a series of preventable tragedies involving sanitation workers carrying out dangerous sewer-cleaning work without adequate protection. Based on media reports, at least 16 sanitation workers have died since April 2026. Their deaths were linked to suffocation and exposure to toxic fumes while manually cleaning sewers. The dangers sanitation workers face extend beyond sewer cleaning. On 1 June, a sanitation worker was crushed to death while sweeping a road. Days later, another sanitation worker set himself on fire in Gujranwala after allegedly facing unpaid wages and unlawful salary deductions. He died from his injuries on 28 June. Reports indicate that he had repeatedly raised concerns about insufficient wages before his death.

Tariffs are back, industrial policy is fashionable again, and over the past year the United States, the country that helped build and maintain the open trading system, has spent its energy tearing holes in it, taxing allies and rivals alike. The popular verdict in India is grim: a global trade war is on, the rules-based order is finished, and we are caught in the crossfire. But is that really what's happening? In this episode of Turbulence, Anupam Manur (@anupammanur) is joined by Devashish Mitra (@DevashishMitra_), Professor of Economics at Syracuse University's Maxwell School, and the economist who has written extensively on the political economy of trade policy. His answer is bracing on two counts. Tariffs, he argues, can't do what they promise: trade balances are governed by macroeconomics, not trade policy, and the cost of a tariff falls largely on the country that imposes it. And for India, the more uncomfortable truth is that the binding constraint was never Washington, but it's India's own protectionism. The conversation runs from Trump's tariffs to the wider drift toward industrial policy and "friend-shoring," to what the future of trade might look like and what India should actually do about it. India's female workforce participation rate among women (15+) has climbed markedly, from 19.2% in 2017–18 to 32.5% in 2025. While this expansion represents a genuine advance on the extensive margin, the terms on which women are engaged raise persistent concerns about the depth and quality of their labour market engagement. PLFS data shows that irrespective of broad sectors like agriculture, industry, or services, female employment remains located in low-productivity activities, within very small or informal enterprises, frequently in unpaid capacities in crop production and livestock; wearing apparel, textiles, tobacco manufacturing, and domestic services. Work in these segments is often part-time, supplementary, or organised on a piece-rate basis, captured through lower working hours, arrangements that constrain earnings, foreclose career progression, and no social security protection. In contrast, women remain underrepresented in high-value, knowledge-intensive industries such as scientific R&D, computer programming and consultancy, management consultancy, and legal and accounting services, those sectors that pair higher hourly wages with stable, full-time employment. Education and human health services stand out as partial exceptions, absorbing comparatively large numbers of women at earnings and hours close to the economy-wide average; yet even these sectors occupy the middle rather than the upper reaches of the distribution. The overall picture, therefore, is one of broad but shallow inclusion. While the rising share of women in the workforce is a positive development, much of this increase has been concentrated at the lower end of the labour market rather than in its most productive and remunerative segments. Expanding women's participation is therefore only the first step; equal attention must be paid to improving the quality of employment. This requires proactive measures to facilitate women's entry into higher-productivity, better-paying, and formal jobs through enterprise formalisation, expanded social protection, and improved access to finance, enabling their transition from unpaid and informal work into stable wage employment. At the same time, policy efforts should focus on increasing women's representation in emerging "future of work" sectors through targeted skilling initiatives, apprenticeships, and stronger industry partnerships. Finally, enabling women to participate fully in the labour market will require addressing persistent structural barriers by expanding affordable childcare, ensuring safe and reliable transport, and promoting flexible work arrangements. Lazaro, Chair of the ASEAN Foreign Ministers’ Meeting (AMM) 2026 and Secretary of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of the Philippines, Secretary-General of ASEAN Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, will lead the ASEAN Secretariat’s delegation to participate in the 59th ASEAN Foreign Ministers’ Meeting, the ASEAN Post-Ministerial Conferences, the 27th ASEAN Plus Three Foreign Ministers’ Meeting, the 16th East Asia Summit Foreign Ministers’ Meeting, the 33rd ASEAN Regional Forum, and the meeting of the Southeast Asia Nuclear Weapon-Free Zone (SEANWFZ) Commission. The series of meetings hosted by the Philippines, as ASEAN Chair for 2026, will take place in Manila, the Philippines, on 18-24 July 2026, under the theme “Navigating Our Future, Together.” While in Manila, Dr. Kao will hold bilateral meetings with Foreign Ministers from ASEAN Member States and ASEAN’s external partners to explore ways to further strengthen ASEAN’s cooperation and partnership in support of the implementation of ASEAN 2045: Our Shared Future. Dr. Kao is also scheduled to hold an interface with the ASEAN Intergovernmental Commission on Human Rights (AICHR) Representatives on the margins of the 59th AMM and Related Meetings. Concluding the series of meetings, Dr. Kao will participate in the commemorative activities marking the 50th anniversary of the Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia (TAC) on 24 July 2026, including the high-level Conference of the High Contracting Parties to the TAC, the signing ceremony for new High Contracting Parties to the TAC, and the Gala Dinner to be hosted by H.E. Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr., President of the Republic of the Philippines and ASEAN Chair for 2026.

POR QUÉ LA DERROTA ANTE ARGENTINA FUE “LA MÁS DOLOROSA EN 60 AÑOS DE SUFRIMIENTO”, SEGÚN UN PRESTIGIOSO MEDIO INGLÉS La eliminación de Inglaterra a manos de Argentina en la semifinal del Mundial dejó una huella difícil de borrar en la memoria colectiva del fútbol británico. El equipo europeo, que soñaba con romper una sequía de seis décadas sin alcanzar la gloria máxima, vio cómo esa oportunidad se desvanecía en los últimos minutos de un partido cargado de emociones y decisiones polémicas. La pregunta que se debatió el medio BBC Sport tras el pitido final fue sencilla pero profunda: “¿Por qué la derrota de Inglaterra ante Argentina se sintió como la más dolorosa en 60 años de sufrimiento?”. En el análisis publicado por Phil McNulty, redactor jefe de fútbol americano en Atlanta, se abordó de frente esta cuestión. Según su perspectiva, “Inglaterra ha sufrido mucho a lo largo de los años, pero como observador que cubrió su séptimo Mundial, así como aquellas derrotas en las finales de la Eurocopa, esta se sintió como la peor”. La afirmación no es menor: la sensación de haber estado tan cerca y, aun así, volver a tropezar, caló hondo en el ánimo de jugadores y simpatizantes. El contexto de la derrota se agrava porque, más allá de la caída frente a un rival histórico, lo que más pesó fue la certeza de que la semifinal representaba una oportunidad inmejorable. “Dadas las circunstancias, esta es una derrota que se analizará con más detenimiento, que generará más pesar, que cualquier otra”, concluyó McNulty. 📲 Leé la nota completa 🔗 infob.ae/4bMw4lw

The new law gives every citizen a legal right to receive notified government services within a fixed timeline, making governance faster, simpler, more transparent and accountable. STORY | US introduces fixed-term for student, exchange visas The US on Thursday tightened the rules governing visas for foreign students, exchange visitors and journalists, ending the old regime that allowed them to stay in the country indefinitely without government oversight. The new regulation establishes a fixed period of admission for non-immigrant visa holders in F, J, and I classifications, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) said in a statement here. The F category visas are for students, the J category for exchange visitors, and the I category is for journalists. Non-immigrant students (F visas) and exchange visitors (J visas) will be admitted for the length of their specific programme, not to exceed a maximum period of four years, the DHS said in a statement. “For decades, foreign students have been admitted into the US indefinitely, allowing thousands to abuse our immigration system by perpetually enrolling in courses to avoid having to leave the US,” DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin said in a statement here. Хтось боїться за свій підрозділ, розуміючи, що після відвертої оцінки дій Головнокомандувача його людей можуть спрямувати на провальний напрямок або залишити без належного забезпечення. Замовчування реального стану справ сьогодні створює загрозу для всієї країни. Ви складали присягу українському народові. Ваші командири несуть відповідальність за вас, за ваші життя і за боєздатність своїх підрозділів. Саме тому їхня чесність перед Верховним Головнокомандувачем є частиною цієї відповідальності. Допоможіть своїм командирам зробити цей крок. Допоможіть їм сказати правду. Від їхньої сміливості та вашої позиції залежить майбутнє України.

With its strikes on Moscow, Ukraine is taking disruption to a new level. The success of a long-range strike is not measured by impact alone. Even an intercepted attack closes airspace, disrupts flights and logistics, and erodes the sense of security. Russia cannot protect everything. It has more targets than air defences. Hitting the target magnifies the effect, but disruption begins before destruction. Yes, Russia will continue firing ballistic missiles at Ukrainian cities. But Putin’s problem is that Ukrainian suffering will no longer compensate Russians for disruption at home. As that disruption spreads, Russians will increasingly blame Putin and his corrupt regime for breaking the central bargain underpinning his rule since 2022: war was supposed to be something Ukrainians suffer, not them. The choice is Putin’s: wind down the war to preserve control, or tighten control at home to keep the war going. I would love to be wrong, but everything we know about him suggests he will choose the latter.

I requested either a replacement vehicle, since no permanent solution was being found, or a refund. Both the company and the showroom flatly refused. ⚡️The three circles belong to one war system. Hormuz, Bab el-Mandeb, and the eastern Mediterranean are the valves controlling the region’s movement of oil, gas, weapons, capital, shipping, data, and political influence. Whoever controls the valves controls the price of access. Whoever can threaten them cheaply can extract concessions far beyond their conventional military strength. The future fight is over route sovereignty. The United States and Gulf states are building redundancy through pipelines, ports, protected sea lanes, new insurance structures, Mediterranean outlets, military escorts, and governments tied into the same commercial architecture. Israel attacks the Iranian networks capable of sabotaging that system. Turkey competes to route the northern branch through territory it can influence. Oman gains power by administering the passage rules. Iraq and Syria become the land bridge whose alignment determines whether Gulf energy can reach the Mediterranean without Iranian permission. Iran’s answer is distributed veto power. Mines at Hormuz. Houthis near Bab el-Mandeb. Militias across Iraq. Hezbollah and remnants across the Levant. Drones against pumping stations. Missiles against ports. Cyberattacks against logistics. One cheap weapon can raise the cost of an entire corridor because insurers and shipowners react before governments establish attribution. That is the decisive asymmetry. A state must defend thousands of miles of infrastructure continuously. A proxy needs one successful strike. The next regional order will therefore be armed infrastructure. Pipelines guarded like borders. Ports treated like military bases. Shipping lanes administered through permits and surveillance. Insurance backed by governments. Air defenses protecting commercial corridors. Proxy attacks used as price signals during negotiations. Peace will exist as managed throughput. Ships will move. Oil will flow. Governments will announce stability. Underneath, every route will remain protected, contested, and priced for attack. The image gets one thing wrong. The Mediterranean circle is too small. The real third chokepoint is the entire Levantine corridor from Iraq through Syria, Jordan, Turkey, Lebanon, Israel, and Cyprus. Its value comes from turning Gulf and Iraqi resources westward while bypassing Hormuz and parts of the Red Sea. That is why Syria’s alignment, Iraqi militia control, Lebanese disarmament, Turkish influence, Israeli security policy, and Gulf reconstruction money all belong to the same strategic contest. The deepest pattern is now visible: Washington is building a corridor lattice that reduces Iran’s geographic leverage. Iran is building a sabotage lattice that makes every alternative corridor expensive. This will define the region for the next decade. The winner will be the side that can keep commerce moving at lower total security cost. Military victories matter only when they change that equation. The final truth is this: Middle Eastern power is shifting from ownership of territory toward control of circulation. The decisive weapons will be the systems that keep routes open and the cheap attacks that make those systems unaffordable. Food crises do not begin or end at national borders. COVID-19, conflict, climate and economic shocks and disruptions to energy, fertiliser and trade have shown how quickly pressure in one part of the world can spread through food systems and reach communities thousands of miles away. At the #HLPF in New York, @IFAD hosted a High-Level Roundtable on a difficult but necessary question: How do we finance agrifood systems that can better withstand the next shock? The discussion confirmed that this is no longer only an agricultural issue. Food-system resilience is inseparable from economic security, geopolitical stability and international cooperation. Shocks are transmitted through energy, fertiliser, trade and food markets. In many African countries, for example, more than 80% of fertiliser is imported. Disruption or price volatility in global markets can therefore quickly affect planting decisions, harvests and rural incomes. Small-scale producers and rural entrepreneurs feel these pressures first. Rising input costs and reduced access to finance determine whether they can plant, invest, hire workers or take produce to market. But vulnerability can be reduced. Better fertiliser application and combining organic and inorganic inputs can cut fertiliser use by 25–30% while sustaining or increasing yields. What happens at the #FirstMile shapes food availability, prices, and rural incomes. If disruptions persist, as many as 45 million additional people could face acute food insecurity. Resilience must be financed before the next crisis arrives. That investment must begin at the first mile. Lord Fatafehi Fakafānua, Prime Minister of Tonga, underlined this and brought in the perspective of countries already facing climate and economic vulnerability. Through #IFAD14, we can bring governments, development finance institutions, the private sector and other partners around a shared agenda: addressing immediate food-security pressures while building stronger rural economies and more resilient agrifood systems. @GovIE | @ItalyMFA_int | @ItalyMFA | @MFAEthiopia | @PolandMFA | @PremierRP | @RockefellerFdn #FinancingTheFirstMile

al-Hidayah Australia 2026 📷 | Day 2: Shaykh-ul-Islam Dr Muhammad Tahir-ul-Qadri Delivers Landmark Keynote Address on Language, Identity and the Future of Faith Australia: On the second day of Al-Hidayah Australia 2026, His Eminence Shaykh-ul-Islam Dr Muhammad Tahir-ul-Qadri delivered a landmark keynote address exploring the profound relationship between language, faith, identity, and the preservation of Islam among future generations living in the English-speaking world. The lecture formed the third and concluding instalment of his international series addressing the challenges confronting Muslim families raising children in Western societies. Drawing upon theology, sociology, history, linguistics, and contemporary academic research, Shaykh-ul-Islam examined what he described as one of the most pressing issues facing the Ummah today: the growing phenomenon of "English-only dependence" and its implications for the transmission of faith. At the outset of his address, Shaykh-ul-Islam congratulated the organisers, volunteers, speakers, and participants of Al-Hidayah Australia 2026, appreciating the collective efforts of Minhaj-ul-Quran Australia, Minhaj Welfare Foundation Australia, Minhaj Women League Australia, Eagles Australia, Minhaj Youth League, and all those who contributed to making the educational retreat a success. He also announced that the next phase of this important series would continue at Al-Hidayah Canada 2026 at McMaster University later this year. English is Not the Problem A central theme of the keynote address was Shaykh-ul-Islam's clarification that the English language itself is not a threat to Islam or Muslim identity. He explained that English has become indispensable in today's world, serving as the language of education, professional advancement, public engagement, communication, and intellectual discourse. Muslim youth, he stressed, must master English in order to excel academically, contribute positively to society, and confidently articulate Islamic perspectives in response to modern ideological challenges such as atheism, secularism, and liberalism. However, he warned that the real challenge arises when English becomes the only language through which Muslim children understand religion, identity, and meaning. According to Shaykh-ul-Islam, when religious understanding becomes confined solely to English, future generations gradually lose access to the vast inherited reservoirs of Islamic scholarship, spirituality, and civilisation that have sustained Muslim communities for centuries. The Three-Language Model Presenting what he described as the "Three-Language Ideal Model" for Muslim families living in the West, Shaykh-ul-Islam proposed a balanced framework for preserving both faith and identity. He explained that English should remain the language of education, communication, and engagement with the modern world; the heritage language—whether Urdu, Turkish, Persian, or another inherited Muslim language—should serve as the bridge to religious, spiritual, and cultural inheritance; while Arabic remains the gateway to the original sources of Islam, including the Holy Qur'an, Hadith, Sunnah, and classical Islamic scholarship. He emphasised that the solution is not to replace one language with another, but to ensure that each language fulfils its unique role. Summarising this model, Shaykh-ul-Islam stated: "Keep English strong, keep the heritage language alive, and connect with Arabic." Language Shapes Thought and Identity Shaykh-ul-Islam explained that language is far more than a means of communication—it shapes thought, perception, worldview, and moral understanding. Children, he said, do not merely speak through language; they think through it, interpret reality through it, and develop their intellectual and ethical frameworks through it. He warned that when Muslim children become exclusively dependent upon English, they often begin to understand religion through the assumptions and categories of the secular environment in which English predominantly functions. As a result, their understanding of Islam can gradually become detached from the civilisational, spiritual, and intellectual traditions that originally nurtured the faith, contributing to the growing identity crisis experienced by many Muslim youth in Western societies. Heritage Languages Preserve Islamic Civilisation Highlighting the importance of heritage languages, Shaykh-ul-Islam described them as vital carriers of Islamic civilisation and religious knowledge. Using Urdu as an example, he explained how it developed through centuries of interaction between Arabic, Persian, and Turkish traditions, becoming a powerful vehicle for Islamic scholarship, spirituality, and culture. He noted that heritage languages preserve not only knowledge but also emotional memory, inherited values, manners, etiquette, and essential religious vocabulary. Expressions such as Insha'Allah, Masha'Allah, SubhanAllah, Tawakkul, Sabr, and Shukr carry profound spiritual meanings that become deeply rooted within a child's subconscious understanding of faith. When such expressions disappear from daily life, he observed, the concepts they represent gradually disappear as well. Access to Authentic Islamic Scholarship A significant portion of the keynote focused on the relationship between language and access to authentic Islamic knowledge. Shaykh-ul-Islam explained that the original sources of Islam—including the Holy Qur'an, Hadith, Islamic jurisprudence, theology, spirituality, and classical scholarship—are preserved in the Arabic language. He further noted that vast portions of Islamic intellectual heritage have also been transmitted through Turkish and Persian scholarly traditions, with Urdu serving as an important bridge connecting later generations to this rich legacy. Without access to these linguistic traditions, he cautioned, Muslim youth become increasingly dependent upon translations and secondary interpretations, limiting their ability to engage deeply with the richness and depth of Islamic scholarship. The Rise of "Algorithmic Religion" One of the most significant themes of the address was Shaykh-ul-Islam's warning against what he termed "algorithmic religion." He observed that many young Muslims today no longer acquire religious understanding primarily through scholars, books, families, or established institutions. Instead, they increasingly receive religious information through platforms such as TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, podcasts, social media influencers, AI-generated responses, and algorithm-driven digital feeds. In such an environment, young people encounter atheist critiques, secular liberal perspectives, hyper-literalist interpretations, ultra-modern ideologies, influencer-based religion, and countless conflicting viewpoints simultaneously. Without grounding in authentic scholarship and inherited religious traditions, Shaykh-ul-Islam warned, many lack the ability to distinguish between sound Islamic knowledge and misinformation. He described this phenomenon as "algorithmic religion"—a personalised version of faith assembled from random digital fragments selected by algorithms rather than guided by authentic scholarship, tradition, or religious authority. According to Shaykh-ul-Islam, this trend contributes to religious confusion, weakening family transmission of faith, inconsistent religious practice, identity instability, and spiritual uncertainty. Faith is Transmitted Through the Heart Throughout the lecture, Shaykh-ul-Islam repeatedly emphasised that faith is not transmitted through intellectual reasoning alone. While rational understanding remains essential, religion is also conveyed through love, belonging, emotional attachment, memory, spiritual experience, family traditions, and inherited religious culture. He explained that many dimensions of Islamic life continue through sentimental and spiritual connections that exist beyond intellectual explanations. These connections are preserved through language, family practices, and cultural expressions that ultimately connect believers to the Prophetic tradition itself. Without these channels of transmission, future generations may retain information about Islam while gradually losing their emotional and spiritual attachment to it. Culture as a System of Meaning Shaykh-ul-Islam challenged the common misconception that culture is merely a collection of local customs or ethnic traditions. Instead, he defined culture as a comprehensive system of meaning, consisting of values, beliefs, concepts, norms, manners, habits, and traditions rooted in faith. Islamic culture, he explained, transcends geography and ethnicity. It is formed through the shared meanings transmitted by the Holy Qur'an, the Sunnah, Islamic scholarship, and the rich spiritual heritage of Islam. Language, he stressed, plays a central role in preserving and transmitting this system of meaning across generations. Research Supporting Faith Transmission Supporting his arguments with contemporary academic research, Shaykh-ul-Islam referred to studies demonstrating that retention of heritage languages strengthens religious continuity, reinforces family bonds, and contributes significantly to preserving faith among immigrant Muslim communities living in Western societies. These findings, he observed, confirm what religious communities have understood for generations—that faith is sustained not only through doctrine but also through family, language, culture, and emotional belonging. A Powerful Call to Muslim Families Concluding his keynote address, Shaykh-ul-Islam delivered a heartfelt appeal to Muslim parents, educators, and community leaders. He urged families not to see language as a choice between modern success and religious commitment. Instead, they should equip future generations with all three essential dimensions: Strong English for success in the contemporary world. Strong heritage language for preserving identity and religious continuity. Strong Arabic connection for direct access to the original sources of Islam. Shaykh-ul-Islam warned that neglecting heritage transmission risks disconnecting future generations from the religious, moral, and spiritual foundations that sustain faith. Bringing his address to a close, he reminded participants that preserving Islam is not merely an intellectual exercise but a holistic process encompassing knowledge, identity, family, language, culture, spirituality, and the heart. PRESS RELEASE Family Expresses Gratitude To All Who Participated in Buhari’s Burial and Prayers The most senior member of the Buhari family, the family of the late President, Muhammadu Buhari, Malam Mamman Daura has, on behalf of the family expressed gratitude to President Bola Ahmed Tinubu and his wife, the First Lady, Senator Remi Tinubu for their role and that of Government of the Federation before, and after the passing of the former president. “It is truly comforting to receive such support from the President and the Vice President, Kashim Shettima, who went to the United Kingdom, and here in Daura, for the days he and the ministers during the mourning period. These have instilled confidence in all of us to face this loss with courage. “We are deeply grateful to the President on his thoughtful gestures in declaring a public holiday and renaming the University of Maiduguri after Buhari. “Our gratitude also goes to leaders of the various countries around the globe who either came in person, sent representatives, sent letters, or placed personal telephone calls to commiserate with us. Of special note were those of the King of England, King Charles III, the Secretary General of the United Nations, the Deputy Secretary General, Amina Mohammed, the Chairman of the African Union, and that of the Committee of Heads of State and Government of ECOWAS countries, and our former Head of State, Abdulsalami Abubakar. “Muhammadu Buhari’s demise is an irreparable loss and its pain is beyond words, but the general reaction and kind expressions give us the strength to cope with the loss of our esteemed family member and former leader of the country. “The family is equally grateful to Vice President Kashim Shettima in his own person and his wife, and to all state governors, especially those of Katsina, the host governor Dr Dikko Umar Radda; Professor Babagana Umara Zulum of Borno State and all those who visited us in the UK and Daura from Adamawa, Kano, Kwara, Lagos, Kaduna, Imo, Nasarawa, Bauchi, Sokoto, Kebbi as well as the several former governors, including Dr Peter Obi for their compassionate words of condolence. Your empathy has touched our hearts deeply, and we are truly grateful for your kindness. "We express our deep appreciations to former Vice Presidents Atiku Abubakar, Architect Namadi Sambo, Professor Yemi Osinbajo, and Ambassador Babagana Kingibe as well as to the President of Senate, Godswill Akpabio, the Speaker, House of Representatives, Honorable Tajuddeen Abbas, Deputy Senate President Barau Jibrin and the other leaders and members of the National and State Assemblies. “We do sincerely thank the Secretary to the Government of the Federation, SGF, Senator George Akume and his predecessor in office, Boss Mustapha, the current Chief of Staff, Honorable Femi Gbajabiamila and his predecessor, Professor Ibrahim Gambari, former and serving members of the cabinet in both administrations for their activities in these events and their comforting words. “We are very pleased with the amazing gestures of our traditional leaders, notably the Sultan of Sokoto, the Shehu of Borno, the Emir of Gwandu and the host emirs of Katsina and Daura, as well as the various emirs and chiefs from all over Nigeria and the neighboring countries who came in person or sent representatives. “We have been honored by the large turnout of religious leaders, Islamic, Christian and of other faiths, community leaders, women, youth and politicians of various leanings whose surge in Daura was both challenging and reassuring. “The family in Daura is also thanking past and serving security and intelligence, police and military leaders, permanent secretaries, and the rank and file civil servants, community groups and associations, civil society, and the media of communications. 1/2

The programme concluded with a Vote of Thanks by the Director DMS.

#WATCH | Bradford, UK | Members of the Kashmiri diaspora staged an anti-Pakistan protest outside the Pakistani Consulate in Bradford, United Kingdom, on July 15, alleging human rights violations in Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir (PoJK). The protest was organised on the call of the Joint Awami Action Committee (JAAC), with participants urging the international community to take note of what they described as state repression in PoJK. Protesters carried placards and raised slogans against Pakistan, accusing its security forces of human rights abuses in the region. The demonstrators alleged that Pakistani security forces had carried out killings, enforced abductions, raids on homes, and violence against civilians, including women and children. They also demanded that the rights and demands of the people of Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir be respected and addressed. During the protest, participants also called for a boycott of travel and tourism to Pakistan, urged people to avoid flying with Pakistan International Airlines (PIA), and appealed to the Kashmiri diaspora to stop remittances to Pakistan until their demands were met. 'महाराष्ट्राची सर्वाधिक सुलभ शासकीय सेवा देणारे राज्य' अशी ओळख निर्माण करण्यासाठी सर्व विभागांनी समन्वयाने काम करावे, असेही निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. ‘जीपीआर’ अंतर्गत प्रत्येक सेवेसाठी 6 टप्प्यांची प्रक्रिया निश्चित करण्यात आली असून त्यामध्ये जीपीआर अहवाल, मुख्यमंत्री कार्यालयाशी चर्चा, विभागीय मंजुरी, महाआयटीमार्फत तांत्रिक विकास, शासन निर्णय निर्गमित करणे आणि अंतिम चाचणी यांचा New Policy Brief | From Mobile-First to Mobile-Plus: Closing India's Fixed-Mobile Imbalance Of India's 1080.15 million broadband connections in May 2026, only 47.40 million, less than 5%, were wireline. This unusually high mobile-fixed imbalance sets India apart from most countries. A mobile-first approach delivered affordable access at scale and accelerated internet adoption, but the absence of a complementary fixed-line backbone compromises quality and risks undermining productive end use, innovation, and network resilience as networks mature. ICRIER's latest policy brief, authored by Aarti R., Shailly Gupta, and Payal Malik, maps fixed wireline policies across countries and translates them into targeted reforms for India: a ringfenced, legislatively mandated transfer mechanism for the Digital Bharat Nidhi; accelerated copper-to-fibre conversion at BSNL/MTNL and faster Right of Way at the municipal level; mandatory wholesale access and an AGR levy offset for rural fibre capex; and harmonised state-level planning to address acute imbalances in states like Assam, Odisha, and Rajasthan. Tonga’s leadership matters far beyond its shores. For Small Island Developing States, resilient food systems are central to climate adaptation, food security and economic stability. On the margins of #HLPF in New York, I held bilateral discussions with the Prime Minister of #Tonga, Lord Fatafehi Fakafānua highlighting the long standing partnership between @IFAD and Tonga. IFAD and Tonga have worked together since 1983. Our total investment has reached more than US$53 million, including US$22 million in IFAD financing, supporting rural communities and expanding opportunities, particularly in the outer islands. Our shared priority is the development of value chains and opening markets for small holder producers from outer islands to main islands and regional markets. The Tonga Rural Innovation Project Phase III marks the next stage of this partnership. Financed by a US$5.3 million IFAD grant and US$4.7 million in climate co-financing, it will strengthen climate-resilient agriculture, improve food and nutrition security, and create new economic opportunities for approximately 35,000 people. Across the Pacific, IFAD has mobilized more than US$400 million in investments over four decades, helping countries strengthen resilience, food security and sustainable rural livelihoods. As we look towards #IFAD14, our focus is on mobilizing greater investment in rural people, climate adaptation, nutrition and sustainable food systems across Tonga and the wider Pacific. #FinancingTheFirstMile

An outreach programme on the Income Tax Act, 2025, Income Tax Rules, 2026, and TDS-related issues was organised today at DRDO Bhawan by the Directorate of Management & Security (DMS), DRDO. The programme commenced with an address by Dr. Ravindra Singh, DG (R&M), who highlighted the importance of awareness and compliance with the latest income tax provisions. The technical sessions were delivered by Ms. Beenu, Additional Commissioner of Income Tax; Shri Y. N. Saxena, Deputy Commissioner of Income Tax; and the team from Aaykar Bhawan, New Delhi who provided detailed insights into the provisions of the Income Tax Act, 2025, Income Tax Rules, 2026, and TDS-related issues while addressing participants' queries. The interactive sessions enhanced participants understanding of the new tax framework and strengthened statutory compliance among DDOs and PAOs across DRDO. The programme concluded with a Vote of Thanks by the Director DMS.

संसद का मॉनसून सत्र शुरू होने जा रहा है। इस अवसर पर कांग्रेस पार्टी के वरिष्ठ नेता जयराम रमेश जी ने सत्र के संदर्भ में अपने विचार व्यक्त किए हैं। लेकिन मैं विनम्रता और दृढ़ता से कांग्रेस पार्टी से एक प्रश्न पूछना चाहता हूं कि आप ‘फ्लोर ऑफ द हाउस’ पर यह आरोप लगा रहे हैं कि इंडी गठबंधन के दलों में तोड़फोड़ हो रही है। मेरा सीधा सवाल है कि क्या इंडी गठबंधन का औपचारिक अस्तित्व है? क्या लोकसभा और राज्यसभा में आपने लोकसभा अध्यक्ष तथा राज्यसभा के सभापति को लिखित रूप में यह सूचित किया है कि कौन-कौन से दल इंडी गठबंधन के सदस्य हैं और उन सभी दलों ने मिलकर किस नेता को गठबंधन का नेता चुना है? यदि ऐसा नहीं है, तो जिस गठबंधन का औपचारिक अस्तित्व ही स्पष्ट नहीं है, उसके विखंडन का आरोप दूसरों पर लगाकर अपनी नाकामियों को छिपाने का असफल प्रयास मत कीजिए। आज इंडी गठबंधन की स्थिति यह है कि एक दल को दूसरे दल पर भरोसा नहीं है, यहां तक कि उनके सांसदों को भी एक-दूसरे पर विश्वास नहीं रह गया है। मुझे लगता है कि कांग्रेस पार्टी को आत्मावलोकन करना चाहिए। आज जयराम रमेश जी अपनी बौद्धिकता का आवरण जितना भी फैला लें, वह राहुल गांधी जी की अक्षमता और अकुशलता को नहीं ढक सकते। प्रधानमंत्री श्री नरेन्द्र जी के नेतृत्व में देश जिस कुशलता और गति से आगे बढ़ रहा है, उसका स्वागत कीजिए। संसद में जिन मुद्दों पर सकारात्मक और सार्थक चर्चा करनी है, उन पर चर्चा कीजिए। - डॉ. @SudhanshuTrived Video
